subject.title: [BUG] exec tool: aborted run wedges subsequent exec calls in same session (regression from PR #94412)

question: Should maintainers treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102160 as the candidate fix for this production exec-wedge report, or keep this issue separate until exact exec-abort live proof is captured?
rationale: The source and related PR evidence strongly overlap with the report, but the issue has production-specific exec/session symptoms and the open integration PR does not formally close it.

options.title: Prove Against Integration PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the integration PR soak or validation to include the reported aborted-exec/repeated-exec recovery path before closing it.

options.title: Split Exec-Specific Follow-Up
options.body: If the integration stack cannot reproduce the exact exec slot leak, keep this issue as a narrower exec/runtime follow-up after the broad liveness work lands.

options.title: Close After Merge By Umbrella
options.body: Close this issue after the integration PR lands if maintainers decide its live wedge/reclaim proof is sufficient for this report’s symptom family.

recommendation.title: Prove Against Integration PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the integration PR soak or validation to include the reported aborted-exec/repeated-exec recovery path before closing it.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the open lifecycle integration stack and have recorded the current recovery/default policy decisions on the related track PRs.
